## Description {#details}

The <code><Link to="/docs/api/structs/micro-os-plus/micro-test-plus/type-traits/integral-constant">integral&#95;constant</Link></code> struct template provides a compile-time constant value of an integral type, with additional utility features. It inherits from <code>op</code> to enable unified handling within the µTest++ framework&#39;s type traits and metaprogramming utilities.

This struct template exposes the constant value via a static member, a getter method, and explicit conversion operators. It also provides a unary minus operator to obtain the negative value as a new <code><Link to="/docs/api/structs/micro-os-plus/micro-test-plus/type-traits/integral-constant">integral&#95;constant</Link></code> instance.


<ParametersList title="Template Parameters">
<ParametersListItem name="N">The compile-time constant value.</ParametersListItem>
</ParametersList>
